title: Keep the latest value
summary: A BehaviorSubject starts with one value and gives the latest value to each new subscriber.

items: `BehaviorSubject` keeps a current value and immediately sends it to a new subscriber.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Choose a meaningful initial value. A BehaviorSubject always needs one.
